name: elite/X-Original-URL routing confusion
description: [high] Alternate-route header confusion (PortSwigger access-control technique): X-Original-URL re-routes the request server-side while the front-end ACL only saw / — a 403 on the payload vs 200 on the baseline proves the header reaches routing. Keywords: x-original-url x-rewrite-url access control bypass routing acl header. ctrl: benign request without the header returns the normal home page -> not falsified. base_url = site root; copy skill for X-Rewrite-URL and for 401-deny or admin-content-marker targets (200-with-admin-body = full bypass case).
